name: getFlagShow
description: Returns whether the Zodiacal Light (faint, diffuse glow caused by sunlight scattering off interplanetary dust) is currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if Zodiacal Light is visible, false if hidden

name: setFlagShow
description: Shows or hides the Zodiacal Light rendering. The Zodiacal Light is a faint, diffuse glow along the ecliptic plane, best visible after sunset or before sunrise in dark skies.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show Zodiacal Light, false to hide

name: getIntensity
description: Returns the current intensity (brightness) of the Zodiacal Light rendering. Higher values make the glow appear brighter.
example:
var intensity = ZodiacalLight.getIntensity();
core.debug("Zodiacal Light intensity: " + intensity);

name: setIntensity
description: Sets the intensity (brightness) of the Zodiacal Light rendering. Values above 1.0 make it appear brighter, below 1.0 dimmer.

name: getColor
description: Returns the current color tint applied to the Zodiacal Light rendering. The color is multiplied with the texture.
example:
var color = ZodiacalLight.getColor();
core.debug("Zodiacal Light color: RGB(" + color[0] + ", " + color[1] + ", " + color[2] + ")");

name: setColor
description: Sets the color tint for the Zodiacal Light rendering. White (1,1,1) gives natural colors; other values create color casts.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: RGB color vector with values between 0.0 and 1.0
